title: Ad Layouts That Protect Reader Trust on Content-Heavy Sites
description: Where to place display ads, inline units, and monetization prompts so the page still feels premium and readable.
excerpt: Reader trust drops fast when a page feels stacked with interruptions. The best ad layouts leave the article in control and keep density predictable.
author: MyAppAI Editorial

sections.heading: Why this matters
sections.body: Use defined ad zones with clear spacing so ads feel intentional instead of inserted at random.

sections.heading: How the workflow should be structured
sections.body: Inline units work best after the reader has context, not before the article earns attention.

sections.heading: What to automate and what to review
sections.body: Avoid stacking ads near navigation, hero messaging, or policy-critical content.

sections.heading: Where this creates revenue leverage
sections.body: A premium-looking site can still monetize aggressively if the layout remains legible and structured.
